LMS INTER-AGENCY MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING THIS MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING made and entered into this Ist day of June, 2004, by and between the METROPOLITAN DEVELOPMENT AND HOUSING AGENCY, the Housing Authority of the Metropolitan Government pursuant to Section 18.04 of the Charter (hereinafter referred to as “MDHA”) and the FINANCE DEPARTMENT OF THE METROPOLITAN GOVERNMENT OF NASHVILLE AND DAVIDSON COUNTY referred to as “Metro Finance Department”). WITNESSETH WHEREAS, MDHA and its affiliate. the Nashville Homestead Corporation, and the Nashville Housing Fund desire to increase affordable housing opportunities in Metropolitan Nashville and Davidson County for low and moderate income persons and families; and WHEREAS, Substitute Bill No. BL 2003-1471 included $183,200 in the General Fund allocated to MDHA to provide $45,000 to suppor the Urban Homestead Program and to provide administrative support for the Front Door, Downpayment Assistance und Development Loan programs of the Nashville Housing Fund to serve low income residents of Davidson County; and NOW, THEREFORE, for good and valuable consideration, receipt of which is hereby acknowledged and the mutual promises contained herein, the parties agree as follows:
1. Scope of Services aA. Urban Homestead Program: $45,000 to provide administrative suppon for providing vacant residential parcels to local nonprofit agencies for affordable homeownership opportunitics, including staff salaries and fringe benefits, printing and postage, land transfer costs, sundry expenses and lot maintenance. ARCHIVE
we The Nashville Housing Fund: $138,200 to provide administrative support the Front Door, a one-stop information, screening and evaluation service for approximately 1,200 low and moderate income persons who want to become home owners; the Downpayment Assistance Program for tow and moderate income families purchasing a home in Davidson County; and the Development Loan Program. which provides low interest gap financing for affordable housing developers. Payment Terms and Conditions A. Term Payments to MDHA shall be made only after the receipt of invoice(s) and any supporting information as may be requested by the Metro Finance Department to demonstrate that the funds are used in accordance with Section
1. All invoices shall be sent to Division of Accounts, Department of Finance, Metropolitan Courthouse, Nashville, TN 37201. MDHA shall provide the Metro Finance Department with a copy of its audited financial statement for each MDHA fiscal year, which covers the period of this Memorandum of Understanding. The payment of an invoice by the Metro Finance Department shall not prejudice its right to to or question any matter in relation thereto, and such payment by the Metro Finance Department shall not be construed as expenditures covered therein. MDHA invoice shall be subject to reduction or repayment of amounts therefore made which are determined by Metro on the basis of audits not to constitute allowable expenditures. The period of service covered by this agreement shall commence on July 1. 2003, and end on June 30, 2004. v ARCHIVE
Miscellaneous Provisions A. This instrument contains the entire agreement of MDHA and Metro Finance Department. This Memorandum of Understanding may be modified only by written amendment that has been executed and approved by the appropriate parties as indicated on the signature page of this Memorandum of Understanding. B. This Memorandum of Understanding may be terminated for cause by either party upon thirty (30) days written notice by either party. Cc. MDHA shall not subscribe to any personnel policy which permits or allows for the promotion, demotion, employment, dismissal or laying off of any individual due to the race. creed, color, national origin, age, sex, or which is in violation of applicable laws conceming the employment of individuals with disabilities. No individual with a disability nor any individual! due to the individuals’ race, creed, color, national origin, age, or sex shall be excluded from participation in, or be denied benefits of. or be otherwise subjected to discrimination in the performance of this Memorandum of Understanding. MDHA shall, upon request, show proof of such non-discrimination, and shall post in conspicuous places, available to all employees and applicants, notice of non-discrimination. D. The Metro Finance Department shall have no liability except as specifically provided in this Memorandum of Understanding. E. MDHA agrees to comply with all applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations in the performance of this Memorandum of Understanding. we ARCHIVE
F. The validity, construction and effect of this Memorandum of Understanding and any and all extensions and/or modifications thereof shall be governed by the laws and in the courts of the State of Tennessee.
